children: (“Ducommun” or the “Company”) announced today that Stephen G. Oswald, the Company’s chairman, president and chief executive officer, will participate in the upcoming 32nd Annual Gabelli Aerospace & Defense Symposium on September 10, 2026. A general presentation will be held at 11:30 a.m. Eastern, with one-on-one investor meetings scheduled throughout the day.
Additional information will be posted on the Company’s website at
when available, including a copy of any presentation material. The presentation will be available live online and can be accessed by registering using this
. Institutional investors are welcome to contact Gabelli to arrange one-on-one calls with management.

Ducommun Incorporated delivers value-added innovative products, aftermarket and manufacturing solutions to customers in the aerospace, defense and space markets and aspires to contribute to the advancement of those industries. Founded in 1849, the Company specializes in two core areas — Electronic Systems and Structural Systems — to produce complex products and components for commercial aircraft platforms and mission-critical military and space programs. For more information, visit Ducommun.com.
Suman Mookerji, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
